utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’d be glad to talk book club. What are you thinking for the next read?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m thinking something lighter this time, maybe a short mystery or a funny novel that everyone can get through. Want me to suggest a couple titles?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please — a couple of lighter options would be helpful.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can make it this week if you want to pick a day.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works for me. Which day were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: How about Wednesday evening?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the sign-up sheet and some extra pencils if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring the sheets and pencils when I come by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t joined the book club yet, but I’d be glad to hear what you’re reading.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be nice. We’re reading a short mystery this month, and I can bring you the title if you want to keep tabs on it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please bring me the title. I’d like to keep tabs on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for book club tonight?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think so, unless I missed a change. Did you hear anything different?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I haven’t heard any change, so I’m assuming we’re still on. I’ll head over unless you get a text saying otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Gus, the book club is meeting at Marlene's this Thursday, and I heard they're picking something a little lighter this time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I know, and I’m hoping it’s something we can actually finish before supper. I’ll let you know if I hear what they picked.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club's meeting this week too - you should come with me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d like that. What time and where is it?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s Thursday at 7, at my place on Maple Street, and I’ll send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help out with the book club. What’s the plan for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure you can help, and what exactly do you want us to decide for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can help. Let’s decide the meeting date, the book to discuss, and who will lead the conversation.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo - I’ve got the book club on my list. Let’s pick a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, let’s find a time that’s easy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works for me. I’ll see what times people can do and we’ll pick the easiest one.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for book club this week. Let’s confirm the day and I’ll bring a copy of the book.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s meet Wednesday at 7, and I’ll set out some tea.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wednesday at 7 works for me, and I’ll bring the book.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club. I think I still have the date scribbled down somewhere, unless I left it on the kitchen table again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it was next Thursday, if I’m remembering right.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, next Thursday works for me, if I can find that note before then. I’ll check my kitchen table and see if I wrote down the time too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I heard the book club picked a really good one this month. What are you reading over there?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I started it last night - the one about the retired violinist and the missing letters. It’s better than I expected.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds promising. I’m glad it surprised you in a good way—are you reading it for the discussion this week?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club? I’m in if you’re going — I can spread the word and see who else wants to come.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Count me in. I’m usually a bit late, but I’ll show up and bring a friend if I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll start spreading the word, and we can keep an eye out for your friend too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the book club's meeting is this week, but I haven't checked the details yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d check the time and place before it slips your mind. If you want, I can help you make a quick note of it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good idea, I should check the details before it gets away from me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can probably make book club work after school pickup, as long as we keep it early.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That should work for me too. Let’s keep it early and I’ll bring the book list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll keep it early after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, book club’s been lively lately - are you thinking of coming by this week?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I think I can make it this week. Put me down for it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll save you a spot and send a quick reminder before the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a folding chair you can borrow for the book club if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thank you. I just need to make sure I can fit it in the car.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush, it folds flat. If it still feels tight, I can hold onto it until you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check which date the book club meets and make sure I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be great, Opal. I’ll save you a spot and let everyone know once the date is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye out for the date and be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you pick a book for the club yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet, but I want to choose one carefully. I was thinking we could pick something everyone will actually enjoy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That sounds sensible. What kind of book are you leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds nice. I’m happy to help if you want to talk through the book club list or pick a book.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can take a look at the list and help pick a good one.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, let’s look at the list together and see which one fits best.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the book club was moved to Thursday, but I’m not sure if that’s still right.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it was moved to Thursday. I could be mixing it up, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that sounds right, but I’d still double-check before I show up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the book club is still meeting on Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Thursday’s still on. Same time as usual, unless you heard otherwise?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure there wasn’t any change.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club is picking a new read soon. Did you have a title in mind?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I haven’t picked one yet, but I can bring a couple of quiet options to the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds perfect. I’m happy to hear the quiet options and see what fits best.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club. I think I left my notes somewhere, but I’m still planning to come.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries, just come by when you can. I’ll keep a seat open for you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo. I’ll swing by and try not to forget my notes again.
